steps.title: Shift the kids to K1
steps.detail: Raise a growth shifting that moves this litter's kids from K0 into a K1 pen. This step completes on its own once every kid is on K1.

steps.title: Shift the kids to K2
steps.detail: Raise a growth shifting that moves this litter's kids from K1 into a K2 pen. This step completes on its own once every kid is on K2.

steps.title: Shift the female kids to Non-Pregnant
steps.detail: Raise a growth shifting that moves this litter's female kids into a Non-Pregnant pen, from whatever stage they are on. This step completes on its own once every female kid is on Non-Pregnant or past it.
